metadata.question: Did the water extent of Lake Sambhar, India, decrease between 2018 and 2019?

data.raw_code: The user wants to know if the water extent of Lake Sambhar, India decreased between 2018 and 2019. 1. Search strategy: - Use JRC Global Surface Water dataset which is specifically designed for water mapping - Time: 2018 vs 2019 - Location: Lake Sambhar, India (I'll use coordinates for the lake) 2. Masking strategy: - JRC dataset already provides water classification, so no additional cloud masking needed - Use the water classification band to identify water pixels 3. Logic: - Count water pixels in 2018 and 2019 using the JRC classification - Compare the counts to determine if there was a decrease - Check for data availability and valid pixels I'll use the JRC Global Surface Water Mapping Layers dataset which has yearly water classification. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const lakeSambhar = ee.Geometry.Point([75.05, 26.97]).buffer(15000); // Buffer around Lake Sambhar const start2018 = '2018-01-01'; const end2018 = '2018-12-31'; const start2019 = '2019-01-01'; const end2019 = '2019-12-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - JRC Global Surface Water dataset const jrcCollection = ee.ImageCollection('JRC/GSW1_3/YearlyHistory'); // Get 2018 and 2019 images const img2018 = jrcCollection.filterDate(start2018, end2018).first(); const img2019 = jrcCollection.filterDate(start2019, end2019).first(); // Check if images exist if (!img2018 || !img2019) { print("Missing data for one or both years"); print("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Count water pixels (water = 2 in JRC classification) const water2018 = img2018.select('waterClass').eq(2); const water2019 = img2019.select('waterClass').eq(2); // Count water pixels const count2018 = water2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: lakeSambhar, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('waterClass').getInfo(); const count2019 = water2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: lakeSambhar, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('waterClass').getInfo(); // 4. Check for valid pixels if (count2018 === 0 || count2019 === 0) { print(`Water pixels - 2018: ${count2018}, 2019: ${count2019}`); print("C2"); return; } // 5. Validation & Final Answer print(`Water extent (pixels): 2018=${count2018}, 2019=${count2019}`); if (count2019 < count2018) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
